'''Bolas''', also known as '''bolo-slings''' and '''bolos''', were a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] typically used by less-developed civilizations.<ref name="Godking" /> The weapon consisted of weights attached to an interconnected cord.<ref name="VI" />

The [[Unidentified Verig species|primitive natives]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verig]] used a bola-like weapon, a long rope with stones tied to either end, to trip the large [[Pryss-creature]]s while [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]].<ref name="AoH">''[[Assault on Hoth]]''</ref> The weapons were employed by the [[Anointed People]] of [[Abonshee|Masterhome]].<ref name="Godking" /> [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] employed bolas during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], where the necessity of a neck joint rendered [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] ineffective against them.<ref name="VI" /> They were used by [[Zorbian space pirates]].<ref name="E2">[[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' (1985) 2]]</ref>
